items.name: ACORN
items.description: Fly to earn. Spend in the Loadout.

items.name: STAR DUST
items.description: Premium currency. 5 free every day, +25 on day 7.

items.name: ACORN COINS
items.description: Debris Field's run-only currency. Spend it at the Depot; it resets each run.

items.name: FREEZE ACORN
items.description: Slows everything for 3.5s.

items.name: SHIELD ACORN
items.description: Blocks one debris hit.

items.name: GOLDEN ACORN
items.description: Debris can't hurt you. Planets still bounce.

items.name: BLACK HOLE
items.description: 15s of warped flight: reversed or tilted.

items.name: WORMHOLE
items.description: Pulls you into a corridor. Tap to rise; gravity brings you down.
